ideas.title: Investigation into Minnesota DHS Data Breach
ideas.description: Investigate the cause and extent of the data breach in Minnesota's DHS, and the potential consequences for those affected.
questions: What was the cause of the breach?
What are the consequences for those affected?
ideas.insight: This story would investigate the data breach in Minnesota's DHS, focusing on the cause, extent, and consequences. It would require analysis of available data and interviews with relevant parties.

ideas.title: FBI's Election Investigations: A Pattern of Irregularities?
ideas.description: Explore the FBI's investigations into alleged voter fraud across the United States, and whether these cases indicate a larger pattern of election-related irregularities.
questions: What are the implications for election integrity?
ideas.insight: This story would examine the FBI's investigations into alleged voter fraud, analyzing the available evidence and exploring the potential implications for election integrity.
